nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b.feature: Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B is a compact, low-latency model from NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 family, suited to quick instruction following and short answers at a very low cost of $0.10 per million input and output tokens.

nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b.feature: Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B is a 30-billion parameter mixture-of-experts model from NVIDIA with about 3 billion active parameters, offering solid general reasoning and question answering at $0.30 per million input and output tokens.

llama-3.2-90b-instruct.feature: Llama-3.2-90B-Instruct is Meta's 90-billion parameter model (used here in text-only mode), the largest and most capable model in the pool for knowledge-intensive and complex tasks, priced at $1.20 per million input and output tokens.

minimax-m3.1-flash.feature: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a fast reasoning-oriented model from MiniMax that thinks briefly before answering, which helps on math and multi-step problems, priced at $0.60 per million input and output tokens.
